description: Cleared Colorado Jobs helps users find current direct-employer openings at named Colorado workplaces that require a Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI clearance. Users can browse with bounded workplace, employer, clearance, polygraph, and freshness filters; inspect a current job; discover available filters; or retrieve citeable public job sources. The plugin is anonymous and read-only, and it never applies, saves, publishes, or changes data.

defaultPrompt: Find current TS/SCI jobs in Colorado Springs that I may qualify for.
